co.n: States of Matter & Particle Arrangement Cohort

c.p: In which state of matter are particles arranged in a regular, tightly packed lattice?
c.ip: En qué estado de la materia las partículas están dispuestas en una red regular y compacta?
c.h: Particles vibrate about fixed positions and cannot move past one another.
c.e: In solids, particles are tightly bound in fixed, regular structures.
r: Liquid particles are close together but move randomly over each other.
Gas particles are widely spaced and move rapidly in all directions.

c.p: What process describes a solid turning directly into a gas without becoming a liquid?
c.h: Dry ice (solid CO2) is a famous example of this phase change.
c.e: Sublimation occurs when thermal energy bypasses the liquid state entirely.
r: Evaporation is the transition from liquid to gas at the surface.
Condensation is gas changing into a liquid.
